what: A uniform solid round Timoshenko cantilever under a transverse end force, at a short and a long span.

axes.frame: right-handed Cartesian, synthetic origin at the clamp
axes.x: anterior, along the undeformed rod towards the tip
axes.y: patient-left, along the applied force and positive deflection

signConvention: The clamp fixes all translations and rotations. The free tip carries endForceN and no end couple; no distributed load. Positive tip deflection is along +y; positive tipSectionRotationRad is about +z by the right-hand rule. This section rotation is FL²/(2EI), the requested bending tip slope; the centre-line tangent also contains the shear angle F/(kappa G A). maxBendingStressMpa is the positive largest absolute normal bending stress at the clamp. Linear elastic small-deflection theory, no axial force or torsion.

tolerance.rule: abs(actual - expected) <= absolute + relative * abs(expected), for each scalar in its stated unit
tolerance.why: Closed forms with at least 16 significant digits. An exact shear-flexible Timoshenko element reproduces these end-loaded nodal deflections and section rotations even with one element; 2-4 elements need no mesh-error allowance. This is not a tolerance for shear-locking interpolation.

cases.what: 5.5 mm diameter over 28 mm; shear adds about 2.1 percent of the bending deflection
5.5 mm diameter over 200 mm; shear adds about 0.041 percent of the bending deflection
